title: Swarm: drain a node out of scheduling (reversible)
description: Runs `nexus scale-out remove swarm swarm-worker-3 --yes`. Drains the Swarm node (`docker node update --availability drain`) + demotes it if a manager (quorum-guarded) + drains the Nomad client. Reversible — the VM stays a raft/gossip member.

observe.what: swarm-worker-3 drained from Swarm scheduling + Nomad; reason notes it is reversible via scale-out add

whatProves: SwarmAdapter.ScaleOutRemoveAsync does a reversible drain (not docker node rm), with a raft-leader + >=2-managers-Ready quorum guard for managers.
